metas.name: Up
metas.description: A heartwarming Pixar adventure about exploration and friendship that matches the emotional depth of Inside Out.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A high-energy superhero family comedy that fans of Sonic the Hedgehog and Spider-Verse will love.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A charming story about friendship and discovery in Italy, similar in tone to the gentle nature of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The fun and colorful sequel to Finding Nemo that follows favorite characters on a new ocean quest.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A hilarious and imaginative Pixar classic about monsters who are more scared of children than the other way around.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A fun, character-driven story about racing and friendship that is perfect for fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: An alien adventure set in Hawaii that explores family bonds, much like Turning Red.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A creative journey through various video game worlds that appeals to fans of gaming and comedy.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A blend of superhero action and emotional storytelling that fits well with the Spider-Verse series.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: A classic Disney musical fantasy that fans of Moana and Tangled will enjoy.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A fast-paced musical adventure filled with comedy, magic, and memorable characters.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: An enchanting fairytale musical with the same magical atmosphere as Encanto.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: A courageous adventure about identity and bravery, perfect for fans of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A vibrant, jazz-influenced musical adventure set in New Orleans that matches the energy of Sing.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A beautiful Studio Ghibli film about tiny people living in secret, similar to The Borrowers.

metas.name: Porco Rosso
metas.description: A whimsical aviation adventure from Ghibli that shares the spirit of Castle in the Sky.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A fun Ghibli fantasy about a girl who travels to a kingdom of cats, similar to Spirited Away.

metas.name: Whisper of the Heart
metas.description: A gentle and inspiring coming-of-age story for fans of Only Yesterday and Totoro.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic adventure about the bond between a boy and a dragon, featuring thrilling flight sequences.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: A larger-scale sequel that continues the adventure and world-building of the first film.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious subversion of the superhero genre that fans of Despicable Me and The Bad Guys will appreciate.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A high-energy animal comedy about zoo animals lost in the wild, similar to Rio.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: A funny and adventurous prehistoric journey that fans of Migration and Shrek will enjoy.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly creative adventure film with a great sense of humor like The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An inventive and wacky comedy about a machine that turns water into food.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A family-friendly monster comedy that captures the same fun spirit as Shrek.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A unique and hilarious family road trip interrupted by a robot apocalypse, similar to Spider-Verse's animation style.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to return a yeti home, sharing the wonder of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A fun musical that flips the Bigfoot legend, perfect for fans of The Grinch and Sing.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A modern fantasy quest about two brothers that fans of adventure and Pixar films will love.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A deeply moving film about passion and life that appeals to fans of Inside Out and Coco.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning story about elements living together, similar to the world-building in Zootopia.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: An early Pixar classic featuring a brave ant, offering adventure on a small scale like Toy Story.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A gentle and faithful adaptation of the classic comic strip that is great for all ages.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: An imaginative adventure about a boy meeting his fears, perfect for fans of Inside Out.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest comedies with a fast-paced humor style that kids will love.

metas.name: Robin Hood
metas.description: An animal-led classic adventure that likely inspired the world of Zootopia.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A funny and sweet musical about a class lizard that fans of family comedies will enjoy.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: A high-energy, futuristic fantasy adventure with a rebellious spirit similar to The Sea Beast.
